prompt: In a crisp anime style, the scene unfolds at a busy airport gate where natural light filters through large glass panels. On the far left, a woman in a yellow raincoat stands with her hand resting on the handle of a silver suitcase, gazing out the window. Next to her, a small brown dog sits patiently on the floor, its leash held loosely by a child in a blue cap who is looking down at the animal. In the center foreground, an elderly man in a tweed jacket sits on a metal bench, holding a folded newspaper open in his lap. Beside him, a teenager with pink hair leans forward, pointing at a digital flight information screen mounted on the wall. A businessman in a grey suit walks past them, checking his wristwatch while clutching a leather briefcase tightly. To the right, a couple shares a moment; the man in a green sweater hands a boarding pass to the woman in a floral dress, who smiles as she takes it. Behind them, a flight attendant in a navy uniform stands with her hands clasped behind her back, observing the queue. Near the entrance, a janitor pushes a cleaning cart, wiping a spill on the polished floor. A vending machine hums quietly against the back wall, displaying colorful drinks behind glass. A potted palm tree stands tall near the pillar, adding a touch of greenery to the sterile environment. A backpack lies abandoned near the trash bin, slightly crumpled. A security camera rotates slowly above the crowd, monitoring the area. There is no snow visible outside the windows, and there is no food being eaten by any of the passengers. The composition captures the transient nature of travel, with each character engaged in their own small narrative within the shared space. The clean lines and vibrant colors typical of the genre highlight the details of clothing textures and the reflective surfaces of the airport infrastructure. The perspective draws the eye from the foreground bench to the distant gate number sign, creating depth. Every element is distinct, from the pattern on the floral dress to the scuff marks on the businessman's shoes. The atmosphere is calm yet anticipatory, with no signs of distress or hurry among the travelers. The lighting remains even and bright, ensuring every detail is clearly visible without harsh shadows. The scene feels alive with subtle motion, from the turning pages of the newspaper to the blinking lights on the flight board.
